data: Apple's operating income rose from $114,301 million in fiscal 2023 (year ended September 30, 2023) to $133,050 million in fiscal 2025 (year ended September 27, 2025). That is an increase of $18,749 million, or about 16.4%, according to the fiscal 2025 Form 10-K. Fiscal 2024 came in between at $123,216 million. Over the same period, gross margin grew from $169,148 million to $195,201 million, which more than offset the rise in total operating expenses from $54,847 million to $62,151 million.
